name: BBQ Roasted Veggie Sausage, Carrots, Zucchini & Peppers with Couscous
ingredients: 16 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Peel, trim, and cut carrots crosswise into thin rounds; transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers; add to the baking sheet with the carrot.
Trim and slice zucchini crosswise into thin rounds; add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with salt and pepper; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are fork-tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Once boiling, remove from heat, add couscous, and stir to combine. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes; fluff with a fork right before serving.
While the couscous is cooking, place tomato sauce, Dijon, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the BBQ sauce.
Slice the sausages into thin rounds.
When the veggies are done, add sausage to the baking sheet; drizzle with BBQ sauce, toss to combine, and spread out in an even layer.
Return baking sheet to the oven and continue to roast until veggies and sausage are caramelized, 4-5 minutes more (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Remove from oven.
To serve, divide sausage, veggies, and couscous between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
